cases.title: Sidebar Templates opens /app/templates: heading, New template button and the empty state on a new workspace
Validation: empty name, then empty subject / body -> server message in the modal; nothing stored
Create: merge-field buttons insert at the cursor of subject / body; row shows name, category, owner, Used 0; DB row shared
Edit: modal opens pre-filled; rename + new subject -> row and DB updated
Category filter lists the categories and narrows the list; search box filters by name / subject
Preview: modal with the template name and sample values substituted (no {{tokens}} left)
Render for a real contact (API): contact values substituted, sample=false; unknown contact -> 404
Usage count: two renders with count_use -> Used 2 in the list and the template sorts first
AGENT sees shared templates with Preview only (no Edit / Delete); API edit / delete of an admin template -> 403
AGENT creates a private template: "private" marker, own Edit / Delete; another agent cannot see or open it
Category dropdown only offers categories of templates the user can see (no category of another user's private template)
Admin can edit a template an AGENT shared (Edit shown, rename saved)
Save fails (API 500): modal stays open with the error, nothing stored
Delete fails (API 500): the row stays and the user is told the delete failed
List fails (API 500): an error is shown, not the "No templates yet" empty state
Delete (confirm): row gone, DB row removed; Preview / Edit of a deleted template id via API -> 404
Deleting every visible template brings the empty state back
